Moderator's note: I've included alternate GFX and a palette file to fix Yoshi's colors on the Overworld, by sacrificing a single color in the palette and moving things around a bit.

To use it, use the gfx in the alternate folder, and import the palette with the Green Star + Red Arrow button on every submap.
